summary.text: Richard Marcellais is a Democratic member of the North Dakota Senate representing District 9 (Belcourt), serving since 2025 (he served in the Senate from 2007 to 2022). His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Agriculture and Veterans Affairs and Finance and Taxation.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Marcellais is the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa Indians Veteran Service Officer, with an AAS in business administration and a structural drafting degree.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1968 to 1971 as a Vietnam veteran, and chaired the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa Indians from 2008 to 2010.
His biography lists him as a member of the ND Native American Hall of Honor and president of the North Dakota Native Honor Flight.
In the interim he serves on the Government Finance Committee and the Tribal and State Relations Committee.
His biography lists him as married to Betty, with two children, eight grandchildren and five great-grandchildren.
